links.outcome: Abstraction accuracy of LLM versus human abstractors against a plastic surgeon reference standard
links.effect: LLM accuracy 99.33% (61 errors) vs human 98.19% (164 errors); McNemar p<0.001; Chi-square p<0.001
links.quote: Overall abstraction accuracy was 99.33% (61 errors) for the LLM versus 98.19% (164 errors) for human abstraction (McNemar p<0.001; Chi-square p<0.001).

unlisted_practices: LLM-assisted structured chart abstraction for quality registry data

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy of an LLM (ChatGPT-4.1) for automating clinical data abstraction for NSQIP quality improvement registry data compared to human abstractors on retrospective clinical notes.
